errors.problem: The letter i is used both as the imaginary unit and as the axis index of the inner sum in the same exponent, so the formula reads ambiguously. The formula is otherwise correct: it is the tensor product of the paper's normalized $F_q$ (paper lines 3506-3510, 3814). The paper never puts the two uses of i in one expression.

errors.quote: This bound needs power-of-two lengths, so it does not apply directly to the prime lengths $s_i$ of the integer product
errors.problem: Overstated. The radix-2 butterfly needs power-of-two lengths, but an $O(T\log T)$ operation count does not, since prime lengths also have $O(n\log n)$ algorithms (Bluestein, Rader). The paper motivates resampling differently: the integer product needs pairwise coprime lengths, while its synthetic transforms over $\mathcal R_r$ use powers of two (paper lines 3499-3500).

errors.quote: The one-dimensional lemma of [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md) treats coprime $s_i<t_i$, with $t_i$ a power of two sufficiently larger than $s_i$.
errors.problem: The page states the lemma's hypotheses vaguely and incompletely, and adds one. Lemma lem:no-sort-resampling (paper lines 3550-3553) requires $p>100$, $2\le s<t<2^p$ and the explicit separation $\theta=t/s-1>p/\alpha^4$ in place of 'sufficiently larger'. It does not require $t$ to be a power of two: that holds only in the application.
